definitions.explanation: An approximate quantity meaning roughly 20 to 90, used when the exact number is not important or not known. Combines with counters to indicate an approximate count.

examples.japanese: {数十人|すうじゅうにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数十年|すうじゅうねん}→数十年：30639_suujuunen⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: This building was built several decades ago.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{数十万人|すうじゅうまんにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Hundreds of thousands of people are living as evacuees due to the earthquake.

notes:
An approximate number word in the ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧～ series. ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ prefixed to a number word indicates "several" of that unit. {数十|すうじゅう} means roughly 20–90, though the exact range is vague.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数十人|すうじゅうにん}: several dozen people
- ⟦{数十年|すうじゅうねん}→数十年：30639_suujuunen⟧: several decades
- {数十万|すうじゅうまん}: several hundred thousand
- {数十億|すうじゅうおく}: tens of billions

RELATED NUMBER WORDS:
- ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: several (prefix)
- ⟦{数百|すうひゃく}→数百：23368_suuhyaku⟧: several hundred
- {数千|すうせん}: several thousand
- {数万|すうまん}: tens of thousands

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何十|なんじゅう}: tens of — used in questions or exclamations, slightly different nuance
- {十数|じゅうすう}: ten-odd, between 10 and 19 — a smaller range than {数十|すうじゅう}
